questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 15, 12, 180

Second row - 18, 13, 234

Third row - 7, 32, ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

First number × Second number = Third number

First row - 15, 12, 180 → 15 × 12 = 180

and

Second row - 18, 13, 234 → 18 × 13 = 234

Similarly,

**Third row - 7, 32, ? → 7 × 32 = 224**

Hence, the correct answer is **"224".**

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some ifs are but's.

All but's are so's.

No so is a then.

**Conclusions:**

I. All ifs being then is a possibility.

II. All then's being if is a possibility.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9724ad70436bca1ae7195cd334513bcebaec5d6982817d782a31d6d72ebe3b05.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All ifs being then is a possibility → False (As Some ifs are but's and All but's are so's and No so is a then so, All ifs being then is a possibility is not definite)

II. All then's being if is a possibility → True (As Some ifs are but's and All but's are so's and No so is a then so, All then's being if is a possibility is true)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d99c902601bd7804a61f0676de86195efb139080b72d8156fbb359271e1f73b.png] 

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the Statements.

**Statements:**

All rings are round.

No round is a square.

**Conclusions:**

I. No ring is square.

II. No square is round.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33f39bfbc9a4ac14bb1ddaed3d99be957fa3970f6a2bb85fd0ea40e51ac955ee.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No ring is square → True (As All rings are round and No round is a square So, No ring is square is true)

II. No square is round → True (As No round is a square So, No square is round is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusion I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs, what will be the value of the given equation?

+ and - ; 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 3 - 11
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Given equation is : 12 + 8 × 6 ÷ 3 - 11

After interchanging the two signs + and - the equation is as follows : 12 - 8 × 6 ÷ 3 + 11

= 12 - 8 × __**6 ÷ 3**__ + 11

= 12 - __**8 × 2**__ + 11

= __**12**__ - 16 __**+ 11**__

= __**23 - 16**__

= **7**

Hence, the correct answer is **"7".**

questions.question: Four students M, N, O, and P are standing in a queue in a restaurant to give their orders. M is not behind O but behind P. O does not give the last order. Who is standing in front of the queue?
questions.solution:
Four students M, N, O, and P are standing in a queue in a restaurant to give their orders.

1) M is not behind O but behind P.

P > M > O

2) O does not give the last order.

P > M > O > N

∴ Here, 'P' is standing in front of the queue.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**

questions.question:
Words given on the left side of (::) are related with each other by some Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of (::) from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Kohima : Nagaland :: ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First word (Capital city) : second word (State).**

Kohima is capital of Nagaland.

Similarly,

Shillong is capital of Meghalaya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shillong : Meghalaya".**

questions.question: Usha is older than Savitri. Suruchi is younger than Nisha but older than Usha. Taniya is older to Ritu, but younger than Savitri. Manisha is the youngest. Who is the eldest among them?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) Usha is older than Savitri.

Usha > Savitri

2) Suruchi is younger than Nisha but older than Usha.

Nisha > Suruchi > Usha > Savitri

3) Taniya is older to Ritu, but younger than Savitri and Manisha is the youngest.

Nisha > Suruchi > Usha > Savitri > Taniya > Ritu > Manisha

∴ Here, 'Nisha' is the eldest among them.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Nisha".**

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : 8 and 3

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 8 - 24 + 16 × 3 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 8**__ - 24 + 16 × 3 = 36

⇒ 12 - 24 + __**16 × 3**__ = 36

⇒ __**12**__ - 24 __**+ 48**__ = 36

⇒ __**60**____** - 24**__ = 36

⇒ **36**** = 36**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : 24 and 3

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 24 - 3 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 24**__ - 3 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ 4 - 3 + __**16 × 8**__ = 36

⇒ __**4**__ - 3 __**+ 48**__ = 36

⇒ __**52 - 3**__ = 36

⇒ 49 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : 96 and 24

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 24 ÷ 3 - 96 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ __**24 ÷ 3**__ - 96 + 16 × 8 = 36

⇒ 8 - 96 + __**16 × 8**__ = 36

⇒ __**8**__ - 96 __**+ 128**__ = 36

⇒ __**136**____** - 96**__ = 36

⇒ 40 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : 8 and 16

Given equation is : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 16 × 8 = 36

After interchanging the two numbers the equation is as follows : 96 ÷ 3 - 24 + 8 × 16 = 36

⇒ __**96 ÷ 3**__ - 24 + 8 × 16 = 36

⇒ 32 - 24 + __**8 × 16**__ = 36

⇒ __**32**__ - 24 __**+ 128**__ = 36

⇒ __**160**____** - 24**__ = 36

⇒ 136 ≠ 36

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"8 and 3".**

questions.question: Eight boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and B8 are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B1 is third to the right of B3. B5 is second to the left of B3. B2 is fourth to the right of B4, B4 is second to the right of B1, B8 is third to the left of B6. B6 is not the immediate neighbour of B1. who is third to right of B7?
questions.solution:
Eight boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and B8 are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

1) B1 is third to the right of B3 and B5 is second to the left of B3. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25ef566c4cfdff6a3df89388d2121579eadb97c361bffdeaf4876812ed6d7afb.png] 

2) B2 is fourth to the right of B4 and B4 is second to the right of B1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9dbb5c810345b642f1ae6f74d13d9e0f90e3a5669fecd9d31b1a37b2e35e6e2.png] 

3) B6 is not the immediate neighbour of B1 and B8 is third to the left of B6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fde6a5c02d84e958f2b44b6472ecc17d61c8d16b89adc9634e0f9993c7834f3.png] 

∴ Here, 'B4' is third to right of B7.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B4".**
